result.riskStatement: WidgetPump battery failure during active use stopping insulin delivery
result.riskDefinition: Battery depletes unexpectedly or fails without adequate warning, causing insulin pump to shut down and halt insulin delivery to patient
result.probabilityReason: Battery technology is mature and reliable; low battery warnings implemented; however, battery defects or extreme conditions possible
result.consequenceReason: Interrupted insulin delivery can lead to hyperglycemia and diabetic ketoacidosis within hours, requiring emergency intervention
result.trigger: Battery manufacturing defects, extreme temperatures, battery age degradation, inaccurate battery level reporting, user ignoring warnings
result.mitigation: Multi-level low battery warnings, conservative battery depletion estimates, battery testing protocols, user training on battery management, emergency backup procedures

result.riskStatement: WidgetPump delivering incorrect insulin dosage to patient
result.riskDefinition: Insulin pump calculates or delivers wrong insulin dose, either over-delivering (causing hypoglycemia) or under-delivering (causing hyperglycemia)
result.probabilityReason: Extensive algorithm validation and testing; however, software bugs, mechanical failures, or user errors possible
result.consequenceReason: Incorrect insulin delivery can cause severe hypoglycemia (seizures, coma, death) or diabetic ketoacidosis from under-delivery
result.trigger: Software calculation errors, mechanical pump failures, occlusion in infusion line, incorrect patient settings, integration errors with CGM
result.mitigation: Algorithm validation testing, dose delivery verification, occlusion detection, maximum dose limits, redundant safety checks, clinical trials
